verdicts.rationale: BUG CONFIRMED: POST /v1/schema accepts negative values for shardingConfig.desiredCount (HTTP 200 for -5) while rejecting zero (HTTP 422). Source code analysis reveals validation gap in usecases/sharding/config/config.go: validate() function checks Key/Strategy/Function but NOT DesiredCount range. This allows negative shard counts to pass into ActualCount, violating the physical constraint that shard count must be >= 1. The zero-case rejection comes from downstream runtime checks (cluster/schema/reader.go), not input validation. Matches bug shape BS-004 (Parameter Validation Issues in Request Parsing).
